notes: Core relationship and UI polish release: Accessories is now React-native with quantity, many-to-many firearm compatibility, and magazine allocation.
Settings is reorganized into expandable submenus for Appearance & Branding, Ammunition Settings, Manufacturers, Backup & Restore, Updates, Security & Access, Application Settings, and Advanced.
Appearance & Branding now includes logo/background uploads, dim/blur controls, full color palette controls, and reset options; user SVG uploads remain blocked.
Advanced Settings includes the administrator permanent-deletion control under Data Protection.
Firearm cards now show manufacturer above model, readable photo/document/readiness footer labels, and Dashboard firearm cards open the firearm detail drawer.
Firearm gallery uses full-image contain behavior, photo actions moved into an image menu, and floating gallery buttons were removed.
Firearm drawer now derives compatible magazine quantity/allocation from Accessories relationships.
Ammunition KPI cards now emphasize total rounds, overall reserve coverage, caliber status and container count; Reserve by Caliber includes consistent cartridge visuals.
Application-wide icons now use one built-in SVG design system with a few ArmoryGrid-specific domain icons.
Maintenance editing now includes round count at service. Reports remain intentionally deferred until core React workflows are complete.
